text.p: Consolidated Eco-Systems Inc said Thursday its chairman Robert Steelhammer resigned.
The diversified technology company said its board yesterday named chief executive and president James Connors to replace Steelhammer as chairman.

Consolidated, formerly known as Exsorbet Industries Inc, appointed Steelhammer, a partner of law firm Steelhammer & Miller in Houston, June 30. He replaced Edward Schrader, Consolidated's chief executive and president until February this year, who was leaving to pursue a career in teaching.
The company Thursday also said Schrader resigned as a director of the company.
Company officials and Steelhammer were not immediately available to elaborate on the executive changes.
The company's stock traded at 9/32 Thursday, up 1/16.
